answers.core: Hiding and showing gizmos is core, and should stay core. It just needs an enhancement.
answers.workaround: The only way to hide gizmos is to manually show and hide each displayed gizmo in the View > Gizmos menu in the 3D Viewport. This is tedious, particularly since each gizmo has to be toggled on and off with 3 clicks. And this has to be done each time I zoom in and out, which quickly kills all joy of working.

title: Add an option to hide 3D gizmos part of instanced scenes
